sources.preferred_release: original official CIC-IDS-2017 PCAP and identity-bearing GeneratedLabelledFlows labels
sources.corrected_release_substitution: not automatic; explicit version binding and separately documented protocol required
source_binding_before_predictions: PCAP link type and timestamp precision
direction policy and any justified NAT mapping

observation_contract.scope: offline reconstruction on the common supported XDP/TC packet subset, not live hook timing
observation_contract.length: IPv4 total_length minus IPv4 IHL; TCP header/options included
observation_contract.direction: destination is justified monitored-server endpoint; verify against label tuple and packet session; never infer maliciousness from port or model output
observation_contract.trigger: first eligible incoming FIN or RST, included in the snapshot
observation_contract.after_trigger: not part of model inputs; later packets inspected only for identity, ambiguity and audit
observation_contract.timing: integer PCAP timestamp deltas in ns; approximation of helper-clock deltas; no floating timestamp arithmetic
observation_contract.packet_order: preserve source packet order; do not silently repair or sort captures
observation_contract.initial_strict_subset: complete untagged Ethernet, IPv4 IHL=20, unfragmented TCP, valid lengths; complete session start before first incoming termination
observation_contract.timestamp_reordering: exclude affected sessions with an explicit reason in the common cohort rather than hiding XDP unsigned-underflow divergence
observation_contract.retransmissions: count as observed; do not silently deduplicate packets
observation_contract.flow_reuse: separate traceable TCP sessions using handshake/sequence and time evidence; reject unresolved reuse or overlapping label windows
observation_contract.missing_start: exclude truncated or unobservable connection starts; report scope restriction
observation_contract.label_interval: accept only unique matching source-record/session correspondence containing the full modeled observation window; reject timeout segments or appendices when correspondence is unresolved

source_duplicates_and_overlap.source_record_id: file SHA256 plus original CSV physical row; retain original flow ID and endpoints/times
source_duplicates_and_overlap.duplicate_source_records: identify exact row and normalized identity/interval/category duplicates; keep deterministic representative and list excluded records; conflicting labels rejected
source_duplicates_and_overlap.numerical_collisions: report repeated CIC vectors and exact collisions with reproduction vectors; do not automatically exclude them
source_duplicates_and_overlap.training_overlap: unknown without checkpoint provenance; confirmed overlaps require evidence and explicit exclusions, never assumed from six-vector equality

selection_algorithm.rank: ascending SHA256(UTF-8 decimal seed + newline + stable source_record_id); lexical source_record_id breaks hash ties
selection_algorithm.strata: binary label, then attack category (label 1) or capture day (label 0)
selection_algorithm.allocation: deterministic equal water-filling across sorted nonempty strata; repeatedly take the next ranked record from each stratum until target or exhaustion
selection_algorithm.shortfall: report actual valid count; never duplicate rows, borrow the other class to disguise balance, or select by predictions
selection_algorithm.pilot_and_moderate: same deterministic ranking and allocation on the source set bound for each milestone; persist each distinct manifest
selection_algorithm.final_freeze: persist all selected IDs, labels, categories, direction, packet references, trigger metadata and six-vectors; hash before model loading
selection_algorithm.later_source_changes: version and re-freeze using predictions-blind rules; never adjust the cohort based on an observed score

model_contract.mode_specific_arithmetic_failure: retain selected ID with missing prediction and error; do not resample to improve coverage
model_contract.tie_rule: 0 if logit0 > logit1 else 1, matching actual code

metrics_contract.conditional_metrics: valid predictions with explicit coverage and per-class missing counts; paired common-success subset reported separately with IDs/counts
metrics_contract.crosscheck: independent confusion-count formulas and scikit-learn; zero denominators explicitly undefined
metrics_contract.prevalence: balanced-sample precision/F1 are not natural deployment precision/F1
metrics_contract.uncertainty: no naive independent-flow confidence claim when sessions are correlated or grouping metadata are insufficient
